species.cim.earth_pony.lore: Earth Ponies lack wings or a horn, but make up for it with unmatched strength, stamina, and an innate bond with plants and animals. They're the backbone of pony agriculture and industry - when something needs plowing, hauling, or bucking, an Earth Pony is who you call.
species.cim.unicorn.lore: Unicorns channel magic through their horn, most commonly as telekinesis for lifting and moving objects at a distance. Talent varies widely between individuals - most specialize in a narrow field of magic, though a rare few grow powerful enough to bend the rules entirely.
species.cim.pegasus.lore: Pegasi are born flyers, strong enough to walk on clouds and shape the weather itself. Their skies belong to daring flyers and stunt teams like the Wonderbolts, and the fastest among them can even trigger a Sonic Rainboom.
species.cim.bat_pony.lore: Bat Ponies are a rare nocturnal breed, most famously serving as Princess Luna's Night Guard. Keen night vision, sensitive bat-like ears, and a taste for fruit over hay set them apart from their earthbound cousins.
species.cim.changeling.lore: Changelings are shape-shifters who once fed on love in secret, disguised as whatever pony they needed to be. Since their hive's reformation under King Thorax, they live openly and draw strength from love freely given rather than stolen.
species.cim.kirin.lore: Kirin hail from a secluded grove and wear their feelings in the ever-shifting color of their mane. Vowing silence keeps their temper in check - bottle up too much emotion, though, and a Kirin can erupt into a fiery, untamed Nirik.
ability.cim.charged_jump.name: Charged Jump
ability.cim.charged_jump.desc: Hold the ability key to charge up, then release to launch into a powerful jump - the longer you hold, the higher you go.
ability.cim.levitation.name: Levitation
ability.cim.levitation.desc: Tap the ability key while empty-handed to start selecting nearby blocks with your magic. Scroll to grow the selection, then tap again to lock it in and pick it up. With blocks levitating, tap again to place them gently, or throw them if you've built up scroll momentum (hold Sneak to force a gentle placement).
ability.cim.teleport.name: Teleport
ability.cim.teleport.desc: Tap the ability key to instantly blink to wherever you're looking, up to a fair distance away.
ability.cim.pegasus_flight.name: Flight
ability.cim.pegasus_flight.desc: Tap the ability key to take off and hover, tap again to land. While flying, double-tap forward to dash - chain dashes while diving fast enough and you'll trigger a Sonic Rainboom.

gamerule.cimWorldWait.description: How story villains move when no player engages them: everything waits for the player, ignored threats slowly grow (the default), or villains act on their own timelines.
gamerule.cimManeSix: The Mane Six exist in this world
gamerule.cimManeSix.description: Whether the show's Mane Six appear as characters you can befriend. Off, the world belongs to you and the ponies you meet.
gamerule.cimSkipCrystalLock.description: Lets the Crystal Empire and crystal ponies exist from the start, without first completing the Crystal Empire Rescue.
config.cim.title: Crafting is Magic
config.cim.dyslexic_font.desc: Show the mod's text in Equestria Reader, a typeface designed to be easier to read for many readers with dyslexia.
config.cim.text_scale.desc: Makes the mod's reading text - dialogue, lore, and the Journal - larger or smaller. Buttons keep their size.
config.cim.voice_lines.desc: How many inner-voice lines can speak up at once in a conversation. Quiet shows one, Normal two, Chatty four. Voice replies always show.
config.cim.reveal_speed.desc: How fast conversation lines type themselves out. Space or a click always shows the rest at once.
config.cim.reveal_sound.desc: Ponies and your inner voices blip in their own voices as they talk.
config.cim.humming.desc: Ponies hum little tunes as they go about their day. Soft: the occasional quiet hum. Lively: often, and a bit louder.
config.cim.player_voices.desc: Your replies blip in your voice, and players chatting nearby murmur in theirs.
config.cim.moments_enabled.desc: At rare, big story moments - like losing a close friend - the picture, sound, and music shift to set the scene. Turn off to keep the screen and sound unchanged.
config.cim.moments_intensity.desc: How strongly big moments change the picture and sound.
config.cim.moments_music.desc: Let a big moment fade the music into a fitting track.
config.cim.moments_sound_dip.desc: Let a big moment muffle the world's sounds, as if heard from far away. Music and conversation voices always stay clear.
config.cim.spawn_in_village.desc: When a new world is created, move its spawn point into the nearest village.
config.cim.ticks_per_year.desc: How many game ticks make up one year of a pony's life. 24000 ticks is one Minecraft day.
config.cim.stage_years.desc: How many years a pony spends in this life stage before growing into the next.
config.cim.debug_enabled.desc: Allows the mod's debug tools (the /cim debug commands, the debug overlay, the debug items and keys) for players in Creative or with operator permissions. Turn off to disable them for everyone on this server.
